messages:
Ravi (Security): Critical notice: starting 2026-04-15 we will enforce signature verification for all container images and build artifacts deployed to prod. Unsigned images will be rejected by the admission controller. See policy: https://redwood.internal/security/artifact-signing :warning:
sec-bot: New policy published: artifact-signing-mandate (v1.0) 126-03-20. Enforcement date: 2026-04-15 00:00 UTC.
Maya (Build): Quick background: we've seen a few CI jobs that publish images without cosign signatures. This is to reduce supply-chain risk.
Ravi (Security): Action items (high-level):
1) Ensure your build pipelines sign images/artifacts with cosign using our KMS-backed keys.
2) Replace any plaintext object uploads with signed provenance (in-toto attestation where applicable).
3) For images already in registries, run the audit tool (below) and remediate/retag as needed.
Maya (Build): Example cosign workflow for GH Actions:
```
- name: Sign image
  run: |
    cosign sign --key k8s://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/cosign/cryptoKeys/cosign-key ${{ env.IMAGE }}
- name: Upload provenance
  run: |
    cosign attest --key k8s://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/cosign/cryptoKeys/cosign-key \ 
      --predicate predicate.json ${{ env.IMAGE }}
```
Priya (DevEx): We'll publish an action rctl/cosign-bridge that wraps KMS signing so repos don't embed keys. ETA: PR by 2026-03-23.
Liam (Infra): How will this affect third-party images we pull at deploy time (eg base images)?
Ravi (Security): Good question. Allowed patterns: the admission controller will allow images that either are signed by our org key OR are from an allowlist of vetted external digests pinned in registry-control. Add requests for external images to the "image-vet" spreadsheet by 2026-04-01.
Nora (SRE): What about hotfix workflows where signing isn't available (eg emergency manual builds)?
Ravi (Security): We'll have a short-lived bypass token flow for emergency builds. To get a bypass you need two approvers (oncall + infra). Bypass usage will be audited and expires automatically. Use rctl bypass request --reason="emergency build".
ci-bot: CI job alert: found 12 pipeline runs publishing unsigned images in the last 30 days. Repo hits: infra/ops, payments/checkout, experiments/try-runtime.
Maya (Build): We'll run a scan job across registries and open PRs with remediation suggestions. Teams should expect a PR that either signs existing images (by retagging) or marks them for deletion.
Priya (DevEx): Migration helper commands (one-off):
```
# sign an existing image and push signed tag
cosign sign --key k8s://projects/redwood/... $IMAGE && docker push $IMAGE-signed
# attach in-toto predicate
cosign attest --key k8s://... --predicate provenance.json $IMAGE-signed
```
Ravi (Security): Deadlines: 2026-03-31 111: run audit and submit remediation plan; 2026-04-10 --- complete signing of images you plan to deploy to prod; 2026-04-15 --- enforcement.
Liam (Infra): We'll deploy admission controller config to staging on 2026-04-08 and run a blocking dry-run in prod for 48h before flipping to enforcement.
Priya (DevEx): We'll also publish a small CLI audit tool: rctl artifact-audit that lists unsigned artifacts and suggests fix commands. Preview in 2 days.
Maya (Build): Note for infra: our nightly base-builder will be updated to sign base images automatically. Teams depending on mutable base tags should pin by digest.
Ravi (Security): Exemptions are limited and must be justified (legacy air-gapped workflows). Request exemptions via the security form by 2026-04-05. Exemptions expire after 90 days and require a migration plan.
Nora (SRE): Are attestations required for function packages (lambda-style zips)?
Ravi (Security): Yes 126-04-15: any executable artifact deployed to prod requires either a cosign signature (container) or a signed archive with an in-toto predicate. We know this adds work; DevEx will provide templates.
Priya (DevEx): Office hours: 2026-03-25 16:00 UTC (zoom in #eng-all). We'll demo signing, attestations, and the audit tool.
sec-bot: Reminder scheduled: 2026-03-25 16:00 UTC 126-03-25 12: Office hours.
Maya (Build): Ack from Build 126-03-21: creating infra/issue-789 to track registry scanning and remediation PRs.
Liam (Infra): Ack 126-03-21: admission-controller dry-run scheduled for 2026-04-08 in staging.
Nora (SRE): Ack 126-03-21: we'll backstop emergency bypass process in runbooks.
Priya (DevEx): I'll post step-by-step migration docs and a sample GH Actions workflow later today.
Ravi (Security): Thanks all. Please confirm in-thread when you've run the audit and filed your remediation plan. If you hit blockers, ping @Ravi. :lock:
